Pink CityRajasthan · Heritage

Jaipur

Forts on ridges, bazaars below, and pink walls that glow at dusk.

Do the fort triangle early, wander the old city on foot in the afternoon, and leave one evening for a rooftop view over the bazaars.

Vibe
Heritage · Bazaars · Golden hour
Stay
2–3 days
Best season
Oct–Mar

Map of places I covered

Tap a photo pin for details, gallery, and Google Maps — or scroll the list below.

Must Optional

Places

  • Must8–10 AM

    Amer Fort

    The headline fort — courtyards, mirror palace, and ridge views over Maota Lake.

    Tip: Enter early to beat tour buses; skip the elephant ride.

    Open in Google Maps
  • MustLate morning

    City Palace

    Still partly a royal residence. Museums, courtyards, and the heart of the old city.

    Tip: Combine with Jantar Mantar next door.

    Open in Google Maps
  • MustMorning

    Hawa Mahal

    The honeycomb facade. Best photographed from the street — go inside only if you have time.

    Tip: Morning light on the east face is cleanest.

    Open in Google Maps
  • MustDaytime

    Jantar Mantar

    Giant astronomical instruments that still feel like science fiction.

    Tip: Get a short guided explanation — the dials make more sense.

    Open in Google Maps
  • OptionalSunset

    Nahargarh Fort

    Sunset fort above the city — wide views, quieter than Amer.

    Tip: Stay for golden hour; cafes fill up fast.

    Open in Google Maps
  • OptionalAfternoon

    Jal Mahal

    Palace in the lake — mostly a photo stop from the shore.

    Tip: Pair with Amer on the same half-day.

    Open in Google Maps
  • OptionalEvening

    Bapu Bazaar

    Textiles, jootis, lac bangles — classic Jaipur shopping lanes.

    Tip: Bargain with a smile; evenings are livelier.

    Open in Google Maps
  • OptionalLate afternoon

    Albert Hall Museum

    Indo-Saracenic museum with a lit-up facade after dark.

    Tip: Nice cool-down stop mid-heat.

    Open in Google Maps
